title: Home Mortgage Loans: combined mortgage exposure cap per borrower
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: combined mortgage exposure cap per borrower

This policy governs Home Mortgage Loans at two moments: when a mortgage application is recorded and when a loan closes and funds. Mortgage exposure is aggregated per borrower and capped.

## Policy clause

The total of the principal balances on the customer's active, delinquent and forbearance mortgage loans, plus the amount applied for, must not exceed 5000000.00 USD.

## How the test is built

1. Take the customer's mortgage loans in active, delinquent or forbearance status, as the bank's system records show them.
2. Add up the unpaid principal balance of those loans.
3. Add the amount applied for on the application being recorded or funded.
4. Compare the total with 5000000.00: the test is met when the total is equal to or less than that cap.

The evidence is the system record of the loans held under the same customer, checked before the application is recorded or the loan funds; the customer's own statement of their balances is not the basis.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Principal on active, delinquent and forbearance loans | Amount applied for | Total | Within 5000000.00? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4200000.00 | 800000.00 | 5000000.00 | Yes, equal to the cap |
| 4200000.00 | 800000.01 | 5000000.01 | No, exceeds the cap |
| 0.00 | 3000000.00 | 3000000.00 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **Which balances are summed?** Only the principal balances of loans in active, delinquent or forbearance status. A paid-off or withdrawn loan contributes nothing, and neither does another loan still in applied status; the amount applied for on the application under review is added separately.
- **When is the test made?** Both when the application is recorded and when the loan funds.

## Relationship with checking accounts

Mortgage principal is the one lending balance that counts toward the checking relationship balance of those checking tiers that the checking account terms define as including mortgage balances. No Home Mortgage Loans pricing depends on the customer's other holdings.
